CustomField.description: Object the Condition is evaluated on, and how many of its records must satisfy it: the narrative; the selected products (at least one, or all); the valid share classes (Validity__c) of the selected products, all of them together (at least one, or all). Empty = All products. Product and share class scopes never pass without selected product. Only read when Condition is filled.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Object the Condition is written on. Narrative: the narrative. At least one / All products: the selected products. At least one / All share classes: the valid share classes of the selected products. Empty = All products.
CustomField.label: Condition Scope
